suggestions.pitch: Shaheed is a zero-projection bench piece; Mixon (22.1 a week lately) and Hill start every week for me, and the 2-7 rebuilding partner gets a younger body.
Theo Johnson is not in my lineup; Kelce and Tua both add starter-level points for a 3-6 team that is out of the race.
Deebo (4.2 a week lately) and Tracy for Kamara (18 a week, 16 projected) is a clear upgrade at RB for a middling 4-5 partner.
